subject: [PATCH v1 2/2] mm/zswap: preserve the workingset shadow across writeback

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue in the zswap compression algorithm where the workingset shadow is lost during writeback, leading to inaccurate anon refault/workingset accounting. To fix this, the patch preserves the workingset shadow within zswap by parking it in the zswap tree instead of overwriting it when a buffer folio is freed. The parked shadow is then handled at the next opportunity, whether that's through swap-in, reclaim, or slot free, ensuring accurate refault and eviction tracking.
